text: GOOOAAALLL!!! DIAZ LEVELS FOR LIVERPOOL!!! A corner comes in from the right, and Brighton fail to fully deal with it with a poor clearing header.
Five minutes left at Anfield, and the visitors aren't exactly hammering the door down in their pursuit of an equaliser.

GOOOAAALLL!!! WHAT A GOAL!!! It's a brilliant move that allows Salah to stroke home and make it 2-1! Szoboszlai fizzes a pass from out wide into Mac Allister, who takes a touch before quickly laying into the path of Salah.

text: GOOOAAALLL!!! WHAT A START FOR BRIGHTON!!! On his 100th Premier League appearance for the Seagulls, Welbeck has blasted De Zerbi's men in front at Anfield! Liverpool give possession away and Brighton pounce.
GOOOAAALLL!!! Or is it??? Diaz thinks he has put Liverpool 3-1 up as he gets onto the end of Salah's perfectly weighted throughball, before his shot goes straight through Verbruggen.
He then lays the ball back for Diaz, but the winger can't find the back of the net for a second time as his tame shot is saved comfortably by Verbruggen.

narrative_context: sudden early moment with little build-up
text: WIDE! As he has done so often for Liverpool, Salah looks to cut onto his left foot and bend a finish into the top corner.
CHANCE! Mac Allister picks out a brilliant lofted ball to pick out Salah in the box.
CHANCE! Gomez whips a delightful cross into the box for Mac Allister.
WHAT A SAVE!!! Verbruggen makes an extraordinary stop to keep his side in the game! After a neat Liverpool move down the right, Salah pounces upon a loose ball in the Brighton box.
The Egypt international gets into the box, but his effort doesn't seriously trouble Verbruggen, who gets down low to make the save.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: Salah tries to kill the game off by catching Verbruggen out at his near post, but the winger drags his effort wide right of the target.
